headline: Palace Suspends In-Person Classes, Shifts Government Work in NCR and 17 Provinces
seoTitle: Walang Pasok Aug. 19: NCR, 17 Provinces | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News overnight brief reports that Malacañang suspended in-person classes and shifted executive offices to alternative work arrangements in NCR and 17 provinces for August 19.
deck: The expanded directive covers 18 jurisdictions as continued Habagat rains keep flood and travel risks elevated.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News package reports that Malacañang suspended in-person classes and ordered alternative work arrangements for executive government offices in Metro Manila and 17 provinces for Wednesday, August 19.

The package lists Abra, Bataan, Batangas, Benguet, Bulacan, Cavite, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, Laguna, La Union, Nueva Ecija, Occidental Mindoro, Oriental Mindoro, Pampanga, Pangasinan, Rizal, Tarlac and Zambales.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The package says frontline health, disaster response, law enforcement, fire protection and vital utility services remained subject to on-site operational requirements.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The directive affects school attendance, commuting and government-office operations across a large part of Luzon during a continuing weather emergency.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Check Palace, agency, LGU and school notices for implementation details, private-sector guidance and the timing of normal on-site operations.
